placeWorkshopBody: The Workshop (Kopdes) is your co-operative. It sells seedlings and buys your fruit within {range} blocks.
chopBody: Chop this block beside your Workshop. Workers clear it in {days} days and sell the timber.
clearingBody: The crew is chopping this block. Watch the axe marker on the map; the next step opens when they finish. Speed the clock up if you like.
buySeedlingsBody: {n} palm seedlings fill one block. Your Workshop sells them.
plantPalmsBody: Your seedlings are in stock. Plant the block to start it growing.
standCardBody: What grows on this block and its stage: sapling, immature, then mature. The bar counts growth-days to the next stage.
palmSlotsBody: Each square is one palm. Hover for its health. Sick or withered palms pulse with a [!]; ripe palms show a fruit.
harvestBody: Picks ripe fruit and sells it at the Workshop. It stays locked until the stand card reaches Mature.
autoHarvestBody: The Workshop crew picks this block every round for a small fee, so ripe fruit never spoils. Useful once it matures.
visitKopdesBody: Click the workshop to see its shop.
openShopBody: Seedlings, fertilizer and pest control are all bought here.
shopSeedlingsBody: Palm seedlings for a cleared block. {n} fill one block.
shopFertilizerBody: One application lifts a block's growth for {fertilizerDays} days.
shopSanitationBody: Clears debris from a block. The only real fix for beetles.
shopTrichodermaBody: Halves Ganoderma spread on a block for {trichodermaDays} days.
shopTrapBody: Pheromone traps kill beetles on one block for {trapDays} days.
completeBody: Palms take about {days} growth-days to bear fruit. Speed up time, watch for pests, and harvest once the stand card says Mature.
